b_01M12F6MBC7721J77EZ0FBKK3N.subject: addition_schedule_risk_concentration
b_01M12F6MBC7721J77EZ0FBKK3N.content: Front-loaded risk is the intended pattern for addition scheduling: compression pressure belongs in the pre-interior-finishes stretch, and the closeout-side of the job should retain slack rather than being squeezed to recover schedule.
b_01M12F6MBC7721J77EZ0FBKK3N.falsification_test: A job where interior-finishes-onward work is scheduled with the same urgency/compression as the pre-roofing stretch would falsify this.

b_01M12F6MBCQ5AHE2QQ3AWSCJZD.subject: addition_retrofit_handling
b_01M12F6MBCQ5AHE2QQ3AWSCJZD.content: Any work tripping one of the three retrofit signals (area mismatch, "existing" language, unresolved spatial location) must be scheduled as its own Retro-phase item, never folded into the addition's own new-construction tasks.
b_01M12F6MBCQ5AHE2QQ3AWSCJZD.falsification_test: A generated task graph that bundles retrofit-flagged work into an addition-phase task rather than a Retro-phase task would falsify this.
